items.name: Neutral product studio
items.description: Original side-softbox HDR and a fitted passive ground. Preserves the camera, all appearances and native geometry.

items.name: Soft enveloping studio
items.description: Original broad white HDR and a neutral ground for product inspection. No automatic appearance assignment.

items.name: Workbench inspection studio
items.description: A bright workbench environment with a neutral ground for inspecting small parts.

items.name: Three-light product studio
items.description: Original RIG-002 with an explicit 1/16 creative radiance gain, HDR-002 fill and passive ground. This is not the unmodified reference calibration.

items.name: Dark metal reflection studio
items.description: Original black-strip HDR for readable metal reflections, with a dark diffuse ground. Preserves all product optics.

items.name: Warm DIY workbench studio
items.description: Original home-workbench window radiance and a warm diffuse ground. Not a textured workshop reconstruction.

items.name: Spacecraft inspection bay
items.description: Original clean-bay HDR and pale neutral ground. A terrestrial inspection composition, not lunar illumination or vacuum physics.

items.name: Woodshop soft-window studio
items.description: Original broad-window woodshop HDR with a warm neutral ground. Does not automatically assign a wood material or geometry.

items.name: Aerospace hangar inspection
items.description: Hangar skylight reflections for airframe hardware. This is a finite product stage, not a reconstructed hangar.

items.name: Neutral comparison studio
items.description: Neutral comparison field and an 18-percent diffuse ground. Relative authored radiance, not a colorimetric calibration.

items.name: Warm tabletop presentation
items.description: Warm table-window reflections and a muted warm ground for household and DIY objects.

items.name: Automotive showroom ribbons
items.description: Long showroom reflection bands with a dark passive ground. Paint optics and material assignments are preserved.

items.name: Mechanical service bay
items.description: Mechanical-bay window reflections for industrial assemblies and workshop hardware.

items.name: CNC tooling overhead studio
items.description: Overhead lane reflections for machined parts. Does not add manufacturing marks or simulate a cutting process.

items.name: Garage doorway product studio
items.description: Broad garage-doorway reflections and a neutral dark ground for automotive and DIY components.

items.name: Makerspace worklight studio
items.description: Authored worklight environment for printed fixtures, enclosures and tools. Retains the actual source geometry.

items.name: Sun-free overcast inspection
items.description: Diffuse overcast environment without a solar disc. No extra sun or atmospheric medium is introduced.

items.name: Automotive turntable presentation
items.description: Turntable-style reflections on a stationary finite ground. This composition does not animate the subject.

items.name: Paint reflection-band review
items.description: Authored inspection bands reveal the currently assigned surface. Flakes, spectral paint and coating thickness are not added.

items.name: Assembly bench soft studio
items.description: Soft workbench lighting for inspecting mechanisms and bearings.

items.name: Strip reflection studio
items.description: Offset strip reflections show small features on polished metal.

items.name: FDM surface inspection
items.description: Neutral authored lighting for real printed-part surface detail. Layer geometry is not invented by this preset.

items.name: Printed-part photography
items.description: Broad photographic environment and a pale ground for printed housings and DIY products.

items.name: Colored accent studio
items.description: Colored reflections outline the subject against a dark ground.

items.name: Black-environment three-light studio
items.description: Black environment with an explicit three-light rig and dark ground. Not solar or lunar illumination.
